name: wikidata_sparql
description:
Run a read-only SPARQL query (SELECT or ASK) on the Wikidata Query Service: the main graph, or the scholarly-article graph split off in 2025 (graph: scholarly). Updates are refused; a SELECT without LIMIT gets one; rows past max_rows are cut.
Returns {graph, columns, rows (variable to value), row_count, truncated, boolean (ASK), source}.
Inputs (* required): query*, graph (main or scholarly; default main), max_rows (1-1000, default 100), timeout_seconds (5-60, default 30).
Wikidata allows 60 s of query time a minute; keep queries small.
Wikidata (wikidata.org), CC0; no API key.
Example: {"query": "SELECT ?item ?itemLabel WHERE { ?item wdt:P1278 \"7LTWFZYICNSX8D621K86\" . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language \"en\". } }"}

examples.query: SELECT ?item ?itemLabel WHERE { ?item wdt:P1278 "7LTWFZYICNSX8D621K86" . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". } }
